units.source_text: 这样一来，他对那斑蝥生存的条件——沙子所表示出来的关心，也就不得不日益高涨起来。

en.t: In this way, his interest in the conditions that allowed that tiger beetle to survive, namely the sand, could only keep growing stronger day by day.

units.source_text: 他开始浏览起各种有关沙子的文献。

en.t: He began browsing through all kinds of literature about sand.

units.source_text: 调查之后发现，沙子也相当有趣。

en.t: After looking into it, he discovered that sand too was quite interesting.

units.source_text: 打开百科词典，翻到“沙”的一项，上面这样写着：

en.t: When he opened an encyclopedia and turned to the entry for sand, it read as follows:
